question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
-- Count users per age category, ensuring all 5 categories appear
WITH user_ages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, birth_date,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1985 AND 1994 THEN '20s'
      WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1975 AND 1984 THEN '30s'
      WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1965 AND 1974 THEN '40s'
      WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1955 AND 1964 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category
  FROM mst_users
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT age_category, COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM user_ages
  GROUP BY age_category
)
SELECT cat.age_category, COALESCE(cc.user_count, 0) AS user_count
FROM (VALUES ('20s'), ('30s'), ('40s'), ('50s'), ('others')) AS cat(age_category)
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc ON cat.age_category = cc.age_category
ORDER BY cat.age_category
